ply: Plywood: sheet made of thin wood veneers glued with alternating grain.
osb: OSB: engineered sheathing panel of compressed wood strands.
mdf: MDF: smooth engineered board of wood fibres and resin; weak with water.
pt: Pressure-treated lumber: preservative-impregnated wood for ground/outdoor use.
spf: SPF: common softwood framing lumber grade group.
On center: spacing measured centre-to-centre of framing members.
oc: On center: spacing measured centre-to-centre of framing members.
2x4: 2x4: nominal framing stud, actual 1.5 × 3.5 in (38 × 89 mm).
cr: CRS: cold-rolled steel, smooth and dimensionally accurate.
hr: HRS: hot-rolled steel with mill scale; cheaper, less precise.
al: Al: aluminium alloy (6061-T6 is the common structural grade).
hdpe: HDPE: tough, slippery, food-safe plastic sheet.
abs: ABS: impact-resistant plastic; prints need an enclosure.
cnc: CNC: computer-controlled machine tool (router, mill, lathe, plasma).
cam: CAM: software that turns a CAD model into machine toolpaths.
sla: SLA: resin 3D printing cured by light.
radio controlled: Radio-controlled: steered by a handheld radio transmitter.
fpv: FPV: flying/driving from an onboard camera feed.
esc: ESC: drives a brushless/brushed motor from a throttle signal.
pwm: PWM: on/off switching whose duty cycle sets average power.
pcb: PCB: board carrying copper traces for electronics.
mcu: MCU: small single-chip computer (Arduino, ESP32, RP2040).
sbc: SBC: full computer on one board (Raspberry Pi).
lipo: LiPo: high-power lithium polymer battery; fire risk if abused.
bms: BMS: protects a lithium pack (cell balance, over/under-voltage).
gfci: GFCI: outlet/breaker that trips on ground fault; required in wet areas.
awg: AWG: wire size; smaller number = thicker wire.
bom: BOM: list of every part and material to build something.
fos: FoS: capacity divided by expected load.
gvwr: GVWR: max loaded weight of a vehicle/trailer.
gawr: GAWR: max load on one axle.
tw: Tongue weight: downward load on the hitch, aim 10–15 % of gross.
tig: TIG: precise welding with a tungsten electrode.
s4s: S4S: lumber planed on all four faces.
rip: Rip cut: a cut along the grain.
crosscut: Crosscut: a cut across the grain.
dado: Dado: flat-bottomed groove cut across a board.
rabbet: Rabbet: L-shaped step along an edge.
kerf: Kerf: width of material a blade removes.
mortise: Mortise: pocket that receives a tenon.
tenon: Tenon: projecting tongue on a rail end.
jig: guide that holds work or tool
Jig: shop-made guide that holds the work or guides the tool for repeatable cuts.
sled: Sled: carriage riding in the saw's mitre slots.
downdraft: Downdraft table: perforated top that sucks sanding dust downward.
super: Super: stackable hive box for honey.
apiary: Apiary: a place where beehives are kept.
compost system: Compost bins/bays turn yard waste into soil.
pontoon: Pontoon: buoyant float (barrel, tube) under a deck.
drive on ramps: Drive-on ramps lift a car's wheels for under-car work.
r-value: R-value: insulation resistance to heat flow (higher = better).
u-value: U-value: heat flow per area per degree (lower = better).
pitch: Pitch: roof slope as rise per 12 in of run (e.g. 6/12).
joist: Joist: horizontal member supporting a floor/ceiling.
rafter: Rafter: sloped member supporting the roof.
header: Header: beam spanning a door/window opening.
sill: Sill: bottom framing member on a foundation.
soffit: Soffit: underside of the roof overhang.
flashing: Flashing: thin metal that sheds water at joints.
ledger: board fixed to a wall to carry joists
Ledger: board bolted to a structure to hang joists.
hdg: HDG: thick zinc coating for outdoor steel.
draft: Draft: depth of a hull below the waterline.
freeboard: Freeboard: hull height above the waterline.
servo: Servo: motor that holds a commanded angle.
stepper: Stepper: motor moving in fixed steps; used in CNC/3D printers.
v-slot: V-slot: aluminium extrusion with V-groove wheel tracks.
covered parking: a roof on posts that shelters a parked vehicle
